defs.def: the quality of sb's voice, especially expressing a particular emotion 语气；口气；腔调；口吻
the general character and attitude of sth such as a piece of writing, or the atmosphere of an event 风格；特色；气氛；情调

ex.s: The style of the first paragraph also needs to set the tone of the whole piece.
ex.t: 第一段的风格也需要设定整段的基调.

ex.s: The character of Sherlock Holmes, however,remains close in tone to the original.
ex.t: 然而,夏洛克·福尔摩斯的性格仍然与原作的基调接近.

defs.def: the quality of a sound, especially the sound of a musical instrument or one produced by electronic equipment （尤指乐器或电子音响设备的）音质，音色
a shade of a colour 色调；明暗；影调
how strong and firm your muscles or skin are （肌肉）结实度，健壮度；（皮肤）柔韧性

ex.s: Some members like to 1_______yoga because it helps them keep their muscles toned, while others love to 2________aerobics - one elderly man says the energy of it makes him feel young again!
ex.t: 有些成员喜欢1       yoga,因为这样可以帮助他们保持肌肉的坚挺,而另一些成员则喜欢2        aerobics——一个老人说它的能量让他再次感到年轻!

defs.def: a sound heard on a telephone line （打电话时听到的）声音信号
one of the five longer intervals in a musical scale, for example the interval between C and D or between E and F♯ 全音
the pitch (= how high or low a sound is) of a syllable in speaking （说话的）声调，音调
a particular pitch pattern on a syllable in languages such as Chinese, that can be used to distinguish different meanings （字的）声调；字调
having the type of tone mentioned 构成形容词

ex.s: A formal invitation letter may use either the third person or first person “we” with the place and date often spelt out The wording and tone should be formal rather than conversational.
ex.t: 正式邀请函可能使用第三人或第一人“我们”,其地点和日期往往写明。

defs.def: to make your muscles, skin, etc. firmer and stronger 使更健壮；使更结实；使更有力

ex.s: You might want to: • relax and make eye contact with the audience • use gestures when appropriate • vary your tone and volume 1 Select a representative from the group to deliver the speech to the class.
ex.t: 你可能想要：• 放松并与观众进行眼神交流 • 适时使用手势 • 变化你的语调和音量 1 从小组中选出一位代表向全班发表演讲。

defs.def: to match the colour of sth 与 … 协调；与 … 相配
to make a speech, an opinion, etc. less extreme or offensive 使（讲话、意见等）缓和；使温和
to make a colour less bright 使（颜色）柔和
